remaining_source_gaps.detail: No public immutable build record tying both exact timestamps to source digests, dependency checkout hashes, patches, and the executed recipe was recovered. ZIPs contain only executables, no source manifest or notices.
Candidate script/build-x264.sh downloads x264-master.tar.gz without revision/hash; recipe commit and FFmpeg version cannot identify that checkout.

Both pinned ffmpeg binaries embed 4.0+1-6318f22. Candidate 9.0.2 recipe version/x265 says 4.2. Thus applying that recipe versions table as the binaries corresponding source is contradicted by retained binary evidence.
Embedded configuration enables 28 external library flags. Exact library sources, transitive vendor/Rust crates (notably rav1e), patches, and notices remain unassociated with these binary hashes.

recipe_plan.action: On a macOS builder, record Xcode/SDK/clang, cmake, make and pkg-config versions/digests as declared build prerequisites. Choose one fixed MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; separate arm64 and x86_64 build roots. Meson >=0.49 and Ninja are declared build prerequisites, with their versions retained in the receipt.

Hash-verify and extract only the ten locked archives. Disable network for configure/build. Use only a private static-library prefix and PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR to avoid accidental Homebrew or host library linkage.

Build x264, libvpx, opus, lame, libogg, libvorbis and x265 as static PIC libraries. libvorbis consumes libogg. Use x264 --disable-opencl; disable optional x265 assembly and CLI/shared library; use the Apple compiler assembler or pin a separate assembler source/tool if required. Build dav1d static with Meson/Ninja, tools and tests disabled; use the selected Apple target and disable optional assembly.

Configure from the locked 9.0.2 source with the declared flags, private include/lib paths and pkg-config --static. Explicit VideoToolbox retains the current macOS hardware encoder route using declared Apple SDK frameworks. Inspect config.log and otool -L; reject undeclared libraries.

Install both ffmpeg/ffprobe, source archives, exact executed scripts and every component notice. Record output SHA-256 for new binary associations. On each architecture run engine conversions for MP4 AVC/HEVC, WebM VP9+Opus, MP3, Ogg Vorbis and Opus, including VideoToolbox. Rebuild twice and compare unsigned outputs before parent updates Mac pins.
